about.subtitle: Fullstack Developer • Maker • Multipotentialite
about.motto: "I build useful, fun or just plain cool stuff."
about.bio: I studied Telecommunications and trained as a Fullstack Developer. I'm passionate about building things — from websites and apps to Raspberry Pi setups, battle robots or model kits
about.interests: Web Dev, AI, Electronics, Indie Games, DIY
about.tech: JS, Node, React, Python, MongoDB, AWS
about.goal: Grow every day and share what I learn
about.socials: I talk about tech, geek life and curiosity
about.closing: I believe technology is our generation's magic. My mission? Build things that inspire and spark curiosity

career.title: My Career Roadmap
career.telecom_desc: I studied Telecommunications Engineering, where I gained strong technical foundations in logic, hardware, and systems.
career.film_desc: This creative journey taught me how to communicate visually, tell stories, and create emotional experiences that translate beautifully into UX and digital creation.
career.bootcamp_desc: I trained intensively in fullstack web development, mastering both frontend and backend. It was my official entry into tech.
career.zara_desc: I worked on scalable interfaces and internal tools using React and Python. I also contributed to UX, editorial content, and branding for one of the most visited fashion sites globally.
career.santander_ai_desc: I built an AI image editor with Angular and LitElement that allowed smart mask editing, filters and prompt-based image generation.
career.santander_form_desc: I developed Angular interfaces that use AI to evaluate and validate legal documents, streamlining a complex corporate process.
career.santander_python_desc: I design Python APIs that connect with generative AI services to generate content and score user inputs — scalable and powerful.
